source: Alberta Energy Regulator, ST37: List of Wells in Alberta (Excel package: surface holes + production strings)
note: Atlas grouping of AER ST37 production-string status (one class per licence, highest rank wins): injection/disposal = a string with Status_Type DISPOSAL or INJECTION that is not abandoned; producing = Status_Mode FLOWING, PUMPING or GAS LIFT; shut-in = SUSPENDED; plugged = ABANDONED (incl. zone, re-entered, whipstocked); other = the rest (drilled and cased, testing, no production string). Licences with no production string are plugged if licence status is Abandoned, RecCertified or RecExempt, otherwise other. Surface-hole positions (SH_Actual_Latitude/Longitude).
